name: Natural Draconic Magic
body:
Your draconic bloodline magic is easier for you to cast.

Prerequisite(s): 3rd-level Dragon disciple

Benefit: You can cast your draconic bloodline bonus spells without somatic or verbal components, just as if you were using the Silent Spell and Still Spell feats, though these spells do not take up a higher-level spell slot.
